prompt: Reply with JSON only, no other text: {"category": "...", "object": "...", "where": "...", "still_present": true or false, "summary": "..."}. category is exactly one of: PERSON_ON_TRACKS (a person on railway tracks, not on a platform), COLLISION (a vehicle hits another vehicle, a person, a barrier or an object, or spins out of control), STALLED_VEHICLE (a vehicle stopped or broken down in a traffic lane; not a vehicle parked at a kerb or queued behind others), OBSTRUCTION (an object left lying across a pavement, path or road so that people or vehicles cannot pass; not someone painting, breaking or forcing something), DAMAGE (property damaged or defaced: graffiti being painted, glass broken, a surface cut or burnt; choose this even if the damaged thing is next to a path), TAMPERING (someone forcing, cutting or picking a lock, gate or door), NONE (none of these: ordinary traffic, people walking, parked vehicles, a stationary train). object: the main object or person involved, at most four words. where: one of track, lane, pavement, platform, other. still_present: whether that object or person is still there at the end of the video. summary: one sentence on what happens, in the order it happens.
